stem: Two irrigation-water sources have nearly the same measured pH, but Source B has much higher alkalinity. What is the best interpretation?
choices: They will necessarily have the same long-term root-zone effect
Source B can deliver a larger repeated buffering load even though spot pH is similar
Source A must have the higher EC
Alkalinity matters only after nutrients are added
rationale: pH and alkalinity answer different questions; higher alkalinity can exert greater cumulative buffering influence during repeated irrigation.
